paragraph.string: Statin Therapy for Patients with Cardiovascular Disease (SPC) is a Medicare Star Measure. We have reviewed our records and noticed that this patient is currently not taking a moderate to high intensity statin. The ACC/AHA Guideline on the Management of Blood Cholesterol recommends patients ≤ 75 years of age with atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease (ASCVD) to take a high intensity statin to reduce cardiovascular risk, regardless of LDL level. This patient has a diagnosis indicating atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease (ASCVD).

Action Requested:
Please review the information provided. Indicate the appropriate action items and fax us the form at {hotline_fax}.
